🎉 Missed Out on Becoming an Alloy Founding Member? Here's Your Second Chance! 💪
Alloy Personal Training Blakeney is celebrating 5 years — and we're bringing a special anniversary offer to adults 40+ in Ballantyne & South Charlotte! 🎉
If you missed your chance to lock in our original Founding Member rates, don't worry... you can still take advantage of our special 5-Year Anniversary Sale. 🔥
At Alloy, we help busy adults 40+ build strength, improve mobility, boost energy, and stay capable for the things they enjoy — without workouts that beat up your body.
Here's what you can expect:
✅ Build real strength & confidence with expert-coached workouts designed to challenge you without leaving you wrecked
✅ Move better & stay active with joint-friendly strength training built around your body and ability
✅ Stay consistent with personalized coaching, accountability, and a supportive community
✅ Keep making progress with structured training that fits your schedule and supports your long-term health
And now, you have a chance to celebrate 5 years of Alloy with a special anniversary offer. 🎉
🔥 Missed the Founding Member opportunity? This is your second chance to take advantage of our 5-Year Anniversary Sale.
👉 Click below and book your FREE Starting Point Session!
